item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 30/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry northeast monsoon will bring mainly fine weather to Guangdong in the next few days. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China early next week.

Date/Month: 30/10 (Monday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 24 - 28 C
R.H. range: 65 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
